title: Tokyo dark in every listed product — Labor Thanksgiving Day plus a JPX group-wide BCP test; the one 2026 blackout that is an operational one-off rather than a holiday
source: NEWS: jpx.co.jp/english/derivatives/rules/holidaytrading/ (HTTP 200, 48,483 bytes, page's own 'Update : Jun. 26, 2026') and jpx.co.jp/english/corporate/about-jpx/calendar/ (HTTP 200, 33,103 bytes, 'Update : Feb. 06, 2026'), both re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research rather than inherited. The derivatives table carries the row 'November 23 | Mon. | Labor Thanksgiving Day | Not Open(6) | Finalized' and footnote 6 verbatim: 'Markets will not be opened on November 23, 2026 (Labor Thanksgiving Day) due to a JPX Group-wide BCP testing (disaster recovery testing) of FY 2026 which is planned to be implemented for November 21 through 23.' The market-holiday panel independently lists 'Nov. 23 (Mon.) Labor Thanksgiving Day'. THIRD PRIMARY, new to this repo: JPX's own List_of_Finalized_Holiday_Trading_Days_E.xlsx (HTTP 200, 11,884 bytes, 77 dated entries 2022-09-23 -> 2027-05-05), the file the jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 ledger recorded as an unfetched limit — it carries 2026-11-23 as 'Labor Thanksgiving Day | Not Open' under the exchange's own hand. Corroborated by statute: Japan's Act on National Holidays fixes Labor Thanksgiving Day on November 23, which is a Monday in 2026, so no substitution applies. Filed estimate on the two standing counts and nothing else: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a securities exchange's own holiday calendar, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED during the jgb-40y-auction-2026-11-25 adjacency sweep (2026-09-09) as proposals/jpx-market-closure-2026-11-23.from-jgb-40y-auction-2026-11-25.json; this canonical file was written by the never-assessed initial research of 2026-09-09 after reading that sole proposal, which stays where it is and is now shadowed. RESEARCHED 2026-09-09 (docs/research/events/jpx-market-closure-2026-11-23.md), which CORRECTS the framing both sibling closure entries carry. (1) 'Not Open' is ROUTINE, not a BCP one-off. JPX's finalized-holiday-trading file lists 16 'Not Open' days among 77 entries since the 2022-09-23 launch; nine of those sit outside the standing December 31 / January 2 New Year carve-out and none of them is footnoted as BCP — Coming of Age Day in 2023, 2024 AND 2025, Culture Day 2023, the Mountain Day substitute 2024, Respect for the Aged Day in 2024 and 2025, the Culture Day substitute 2024. Two to four non-New-Year total blackouts a year is the run rate, so jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22's 'BCP testing is the only mechanism that flips a day to Not Open' and jpx-market-closure-2026-12-31's restatement of it are both wrong on the exchange's own data. (2) The blackout is a property of the FY2026 BCP WINDOW, not of the holiday: 2022-11-23 traded Open, the 2025-11-24 substitute traded Open, and JPX already schedules 2027-11-23 as 'Open'. Both published BCP windows (FY2026 Nov 21-23, FY2027 Sep 18-20) are Saturday-Sunday-Monday blocks, so the test costs the exchange exactly one market day. (3) The total blackout has NO MEASURED CONSEQUENCE. On the exchange's own labels, the first ^N225 cash session after a 'Not Open' holiday runs mean |close-to-close| 1.536% (n=12) against 1.404% after an 'Open' one (n=39), Welch t=0.39; restricted to gaps spanning exactly one unmatched US session, 1.497% (n=9) vs 1.360% (n=34), t=0.38. Whether Osaka prices Nikkei futures through the closure or not does not move the bar that follows. (4) The same file VALIDATES the missing-bar holiday classification the sibling ledgers were built on: across 2022-09-23 -> 2026-09-09 all 62 in-window finalized entries are absent from the ^N225 cash series and all 65 weekday cash gaps are accounted for, zero mismatches either direction — the honest limit jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 flagged is retired, not repeated. IMPACT LOW and unmoved by any of the above: a foreign-exchange closure moves nothing by itself, this repo tracks no Japan-listed symbol, and a grep of docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md for 'holiday|jpx|tokyo|nikkei|closure|thanksgiving|bcp' returns zero hits in both, re-run 2026-09-09. CORRIDOR: the week is mirrored — Tokyo is dark Monday 11-23 while the US runs a full session carrying treasury-2y-note-2026-11-23, then the US is dark Thursday 11-26 (thanksgiving-market-closure-2026-11-26) and short Friday 11-27 (thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27, sifma-bond-early-close-2026-11-27) while Tokyo trades both. JGB futures, options on JGB futures and interest-rate futures are ineligible for holiday trading in every case, so the rates leg is dark on 11-23 two sessions before jgb-40y-auction-2026-11-25; that auction's own ledger measured the consequence and found none at conventional significance (cover 2.820, n=19, in holiday-shortened weeks vs 3.044, n=76; t=-1.69 raw and -0.168, t=-1.07, neighbour-matched). Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
